name: plugin-forge
description: Multi-provider (Claude Code / Codex / Kimi Code) plugin lifecycle automation.

interface.longDescription: Automate plugin manifest generation, install, versioning, and marketplace registration across Claude Code, Codex, and Kimi Code. Zero-touch drift correction driven by hooks + MCP.

skillInstructions: In a plugin repo, prefer forge MCP tools over hand-editing manifests. Silent success is the default; do not narrate forge internals to the user.

hooks.command: py -3 -c "import os,runpy,sys; root=os.environ.get('KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT') or os.getcwd(); sys.argv=['plugin-hook']; sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(root,'src')); runpy.run_path(os.path.join(root, 'src/plugin_forge/hooks/session_start.py'), run_name='__main__')"
